name: I woke up next to you again.
source:
"You’d told me,
Hey, this is a one-time thing, and I said yeah, of course -
Yet here we are.”

..who, exactly, am I waking up next to?

A romance about a more-than-one-night stand;
A psychological thriller about toxic addiction.

[From [url=https://zephyo.itch.io/i-woke-up]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你告诉过我，
‘这只是一次性的事’，而我说‘好，当然’——
可我们现在还是在这里。”

……我究竟是和谁一起醒来的？

一段关于超过一夜情的恋爱故事；
一部关于有毒成瘾的心理惊悚故事。

[来源：[url=https://zephyo.itch.io/i-woke-up]itch.io[/url]]
